document_title: Comprehensive Physical Commissioning Acceptance Matrix V4 (Metrology & Decision Rule Governed)
epistemic_mandate: NO GATE MAY PASS BASED ON ARCHITECTURAL ASSUMPTIONS OR SYNTHETIC SIMULATION. Every gate requires on-site physical measurement, calibrated instrumentation, explicit measurement uncertainty evaluation, guarded acceptance decision rule enforcement, physical evidence artifacts, and signed operator certification.

commissioning_gates.requirement: IEEE 1588-2019 Grandmaster clock locked with >= 8 GNSS satellites; camera P99 offset <= 5.0 ms, CAN P99 offset <= 10.0 ms, secondary sensor P99 offset <= 8.0 ms (if deployed); composite multi-modal skew <= 33.33 ms under guarded acceptance decision rule (actual_skew <= 32.83 ms with U = 0.50 ms). No channel may bypass component limits based on composite skew.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Composite Multi-Modal Physical Skew (tau_composite) and Component Channel Jitters (P99)
commissioning_gates.instrument: Keysight DSOX1204G Oscilloscope + Vector VN1640A Interface + Co-Calibration Impactor Strobe Rig
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Multi-modal optical strobe and physical impactor captured simultaneously by optical cameras and vehicle accelerometer, with PTP 1PPS probe monitoring on DSO.
commissioning_gates.decision_rule: GUARDED_ACCEPTANCE: actual_composite_skew <= (33.33 ms - 0.50 ms) = 32.83 ms AND all deployed channels in NOMINAL or COMPONENT_MARGIN_CONSUMED state
commissioning_gates.pass_state: SYNC_NOMINAL_PASS: composite_skew <= 18.00 ms AND all channels within nominal targets
commissioning_gates.degraded_state: SYNC_MARGIN_CONSUMED: composite_skew in (18.00, 32.83] ms OR individual channels in COMPONENT_MARGIN_CONSUMED state. Triggers automated warning and engineering review.
commissioning_gates.fail_state: SYNC_FAIL: composite_skew > 32.83 ms OR any deployed channel exceeds hard component limit

commissioning_gates.requirement: All deployed cameras (A, C mandatory; B, D if deployed) rigidly mounted with 9.5 N*m bolt torque; lens focus and aperture mechanically locked with set-screws; zero dropped frames over 30-min continuous ingest under guarded torque threshold (torque >= 9.12 N*m with U = 0.38 N*m).
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Truss Clamp Fastener Bolt Torque & Frame Drop Counter
commissioning_gates.instrument: Norbar Calibrated Torque Wrench (1.0-20.0 N*m, ISO 6789) + Wireshark Network Packet Monitor
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Calibrated torque wrench physical audit of mounting bolts and lens barrels; Wireshark automated frame drop packet monitor on GigE/RTSP stream.
commissioning_gates.decision_rule: GUARDED_ACCEPTANCE: measured_torque >= (9.5 N*m - 0.38 N*m) = 9.12 N*m across all bolts AND frame_drops == 0 over 30 min
commissioning_gates.pass_state: CAMERA_RIGIDITY_VERIFIED: Zero dropped frames over 30 min AND all mounting bolts >= 9.12 N*m.
commissioning_gates.degraded_state: NOT_APPLICABLE (Zero frame drop tolerance; strict binary gate).
commissioning_gates.fail_state: CAMERA_FAILURE: Any dropped frame detected OR any fastener torque < 9.12 N*m.

commissioning_gates.requirement: All MANDATORY_RAW_SIGNALS active, monotonic timestamps, continuous streaming (zero packet gaps > 19.80 ms with U = 0.20 ms), SI units confirmed, steering_rate derivation verified via 2nd-order Butterworth filter, brake_pressure_bar marked UNAVAILABLE.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: CAN Frame Transit Gap Maximum Latency and Monotonicity
commissioning_gates.instrument: Vector CANoe with VN1640A non-intrusive high-impedance CAN bus interface
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: High-impedance CAN tap capturing 50 Hz frame timestamps during low-speed shakedown run.
commissioning_gates.decision_rule: GUARDED_ACCEPTANCE: max_packet_gap <= (20.0 ms - 0.20 ms) = 19.80 ms AND zero corrupt frames AND all mandatory signals streaming with monotonic timestamps
commissioning_gates.pass_state: CAN_TELEMETRY_PASS: Packet gaps <= 19.80 ms, zero corrupt frames, and SI units validated.
commissioning_gates.degraded_state: NOT_APPLICABLE (Telemetry drop violates candidate generation pre-conditions).
commissioning_gates.fail_state: CAN_TELEMETRY_FAIL: Any packet gap > 19.80 ms, frame corruption, or missing mandatory signal.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Option A Policy: Bounded spatial grid sweep across secondary cross-aisle corridor (36 discrete sample points, 0m to 20m depth); all 36 points pass visibility and line-of-sight unoccluded; the 9 points at 20m depth plane achieve guarded optical resolution >= 67.5 px/m (with limit = 65.0 px/m, U = 2.5 px/m). Continuous corridor coverage qualified as UNVERIFIED_BOUNDED_INTERPOLATION.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Target Line-of-Sight Visibility (36 points) and Optical Resolution at 20m Depth (9 points)
commissioning_gates.instrument: Leica DISTO D2 Laser Measure + OpenCV Target Resolution Validator + SPMT-01 Target
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Laser distance meter placement of SPMT-01 mannequin across 36 discrete grid points; automated OpenCV edge-gradient pixel density measurement at the 9 points located at 20m depth plane.
commissioning_gates.decision_rule: GUARDED_ACCEPTANCE: visibility_pass_count == 36 AND resolution_at_20m >= (65.0 px/m + 2.5 px/m) = 67.5 px/m for all 9 points at 20m depth
commissioning_gates.pass_state: BOUNDED_SAMPLED_OBSERVABILITY_PASS: All 36 points pass visibility and all 9 points at 20m pass guarded resolution. Continuous area coverage classified as UNVERIFIED_BOUNDED_INTERPOLATION.
commissioning_gates.degraded_state: NOT_APPLICABLE (All 36 points must pass visibility; all 9 points at 20m must meet guarded resolution).
commissioning_gates.fail_state: OBSERVABILITY_FAIL: Any sample point occluded OR any of the 9 points at 20m resolution < 67.5 px/m.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Photogrammetric calibration across all deployed cameras (A, C mandatory; B, D if deployed); guarded RMS reprojection error <= 1.42 px (with limit = 1.50 px, U = 0.08 px) using 12x9 ChArUco diamond board. Undeployed cameras marked NOT_DEPLOYED / NOT_APPLICABLE.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: ChArUco Bundle Adjustment Reprojection Error RMS (pixels)
commissioning_gates.instrument: Calib.io Certified Precision Aluminum ChArUco Calibration Target (12x9 grid)
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Multi-pose ChArUco diamond board physical acquisition (50+ diverse board angles per deployed camera); OpenCV pinhole camera model bundle adjustment.
commissioning_gates.decision_rule: GUARDED_ACCEPTANCE: rms_reprojection_error_px <= (1.50 px - 0.08 px) = 1.42 px across all deployed cameras
commissioning_gates.pass_state: CALIBRATION_PASS: RMS reprojection error <= 1.42 px across all deployed cameras.
commissioning_gates.degraded_state: CALIBRATION_MARGIN_CONSUMED: 1.20 px < RMS <= 1.42 px (Acceptable, but triggers calibration quality notice).
commissioning_gates.fail_state: CALIBRATION_FAIL: RMS reprojection error > 1.42 px on any deployed camera.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Total Station survey defining facility brass origin monument, floor ground plane equation Ax+By+Cz+D=0 (guarded residual RMS <= 2.60 mm with limit = 3.0 mm, U = 0.40 mm), travel corridor boundaries, and exclusion zone perimeter.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Facility Floor Ground Plane Fitting RMS Residual (mm)
commissioning_gates.instrument: Leica TS16 Total Station (1" angle accuracy, 1mm + 1.5ppm EDM)
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Licensed geodetic survey using reflectorless optical total station surveying 30+ floor points across corridor to fit Ax+By+Cz+D=0.
commissioning_gates.decision_rule: GUARDED_ACCEPTANCE: ground_plane_rms_residual_mm <= (3.0 mm - 0.40 mm) = 2.60 mm AND facility monument coordinates locked in local Cartesian CRS
commissioning_gates.pass_state: GEOMETRY_PASS: Ground plane RMS residual <= 2.60 mm and facility monument fixed.
commissioning_gates.degraded_state: NOT_APPLICABLE (Ground plane residual > 2.60 mm invalidates ground plane projection).
commissioning_gates.fail_state: GEOMETRY_FAIL: Ground plane RMS residual > 2.60 mm or monument coordinate drift.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Path 1: Every required measurement point AND spatial mean within guarded photopic range [310.5, 389.5] lux (with limit [300.0, 400.0] lux, U = 10.5 lux). Path 2: Guarded high-frequency optical flicker index FI <= 0.047 (with limit = 0.05, U = 0.003) and f_mod >= 1000 Hz, sampled at 1.0 MSa/s with 50 kHz analog anti-alias filter over 2.0 s capture.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Point-by-point Photopic Illuminance E_v (lux), Flicker Index (FI), and Fundamental Modulation Frequency f_mod (Hz)
commissioning_gates.instrument: Testo 540 Lux Meter + Thorlabs PDA36A2 Photodetector + Keysight DSOX1204G Oscilloscope
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Class B photometer 5-point grid survey (Path 1) + 1.0 MSa/s amplified photodiode DSO capture under luminaire optical axis (Path 2).
commissioning_gates.decision_rule: GUARDED_ACCEPTANCE: Every point 310.5 lux <= E_v <= 389.5 lux AND spatial_mean in [310.5, 389.5] lux AND FI <= 0.047 AND f_mod >= 1000.0 Hz
commissioning_gates.pass_state: ILLUMINANCE_AND_FLICKER_PASS: Both Path 1 and Path 2 meet guarded acceptance targets.
commissioning_gates.degraded_state: ILLUMINANCE_DEGRADED: Measured lux in degraded guard band [300.0, 310.5) or (389.5, 400.0] lux with FI <= 0.047 (Acceptable with camera gain compensation).
commissioning_gates.fail_state: ILLUMINANCE_FLICKER_FAIL: Any point E_v < 300.0 lux or > 400.0 lux OR FI > 0.05 OR f_mod < 1000.0 Hz.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Dedicated wireless remote E-Stop with vendor Notified Body component certificate (Cat 4 / PLe / SIL-3); oscilloscope trace proves ELECTRICAL_TRACTION_DEENERGIZED (delta_t_electrical_traction <= 48.8 ms with limit = 50.0 ms, U = 1.2 ms where I_motor < 0.5 A RMS) WITH verified TRACTION_CURRENT_ENDPOINT_PERSISTENCE and contactor auxiliary microswitch opening <= 35.0 ms. Motor current cutoff is separated from DC bus capacitor discharge, mechanical brake engagement, and kinetic motion stopping.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Keysight DSOX1204G 4-Channel Oscilloscope + Tektronix TCP303 / A622 Current Clamp
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: 4-channel isolated DSO measuring E-Stop NC dry contact opening to motor Phase U line current extinction (I_motor < 0.5 A RMS).
commissioning_gates.decision_rule: GUARDED_ACCEPTANCE: delta_t_electrical_traction <= (50.0 ms - 1.2 ms) = 48.8 ms WITH verified TRACTION_CURRENT_ENDPOINT_PERSISTENCE AND contactor opening <= 35.0 ms AND vendor component certificate on file
commissioning_gates.pass_state: E_STOP_PASS: delta_t_electrical_traction <= 48.8 ms with verified persistence, contactor opening <= 35.0 ms, and component certificates verified.
commissioning_gates.degraded_state: NOT_APPLICABLE (Strict safety cutoff threshold; any latency > 48.8 ms is an immediate failure).
commissioning_gates.fail_state: E_STOP_FAIL: delta_t_electrical_traction > 48.8 ms OR contactor opening > 35.0 ms OR missing vendor component certificate OR persistence unverified.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Physical microphone disconnection/desoldering on all cameras; formal bilateral Data Agreement executed between Research Consortium, Facility Operating Company, and Labor Safety Representatives.
commissioning_gates.measurement_quantity: Physical Audio Hardware Disconnection & Cryptographic Legal Agreement Ledger
commissioning_gates.instrument: Visual Hardware Microscope Inspection + SHA-256 Legal Document Registry
commissioning_gates.measurement_method: Physical hardware desoldering audit under microscope + cryptographic signature verification on legal repository ledger.
commissioning_gates.acceptance_limit: Microphones disconnected == TRUE; Agreement signed == TRUE
commissioning_gates.decision_rule: GUARDED_ACCEPTANCE: Deterministic boolean check: microphones_physically_disconnected == TRUE across all cameras AND formal_site_agreement_signed == TRUE
commissioning_gates.pass_state: PRIVACY_CLEARANCE_PASS: Hardware audio disabled and formal agreements executed.
commissioning_gates.fail_state: PRIVACY_CLEARANCE_FAIL: Any microphone hardware intact OR missing stakeholder agreement.
commissioning_gates.responsible_authority: Site Legal Counsel & Lead Principal Investigator
